correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=3, a symmetric nonzero-field potential proves eventual period <=2. Structural propagation of changing degree-two rim vertices leaves exactly one all-flipping orbit (even n) or a pair-flipping root/leaf orbit for every run-constrained opposite-end word. Its exact composition generating function is the difference of Fibonacci and six-periodic rational functions. Equilibria are bijective with cyclic words without singleton runs; the 4x4 matrix characteristic polynomial yields Lucas plus cyclotomic terms. Direct step-function enumeration for 524272 states across n=3..17 and independent trace/composition checks n=3..100 agree. No unproved global implication is inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: This is the smallest pendant-vertex perturbation of a cycle. It leaves the equilibrium population exactly invariant yet creates Fibonacci-rate many additional primitive two-cycles, including the first oscillations on odd cycles n>=5. The complete all-size labelled orbit count and explicit flip-set mechanism resolve a natural dynamical classification. No claims of basin times or larger perturbations are made.
